title: TECA Builder — Lessons From Validation Failures

content: Key lesson: Relying on upstream tasks to produce essential artifacts (requirements, components, configs) introduces cascading risk. Validation and repository publishing cannot succeed if any dependency fails or omits its output. To avoid this, enforce pre-validation artifact checks and consider redundant generation/backup for required files. Future runs should implement stricter pipeline controls for REQUIRED artifacts, so missing data causes immediate and explicit failure with clear next-action guidance.
